description.en: Custom DeepSeek Harness bundles from OMA: story boards, skill gating, the Pi subagent, and info systems.
description.zh: OMA 出品的 DeepSeek Harness 自定义插件：用户故事看板、技能门控、Pi 子智能体与信息系统。

description.en: Products, projects, boards, and user stories, with agent tools that create, import, and move them.
description.zh: 产品、项目、看板与用户故事，内置创建、导入与移动故事的 Agent 工具。

description.en: Per-session skill visibility: choose which skills the model can see from a control under the composer.
description.zh: 按会话控制技能可见性：在输入框下方选择模型本次可用的技能。

description.en: Run the Pi coding agent as an isolated subagent, with resumable sessions over Pi RPC.
description.zh: 把 Pi 编码智能体作为隔离子智能体运行，基于 Pi RPC 支持会话续接。

description.en: Turn one sentence into a running internal information system: AI blueprinting, a visual wizard, and a deterministic renderer.
description.zh: 一句话生成可运行的内部信息系统：AI 需求蓝图、可视化向导与确定性渲染器。
